2: END

name: malformed-tail-after-high
text:
VERT
DCL IN[0]
DCL OUT[0], POSITION
DCL OUT[1], GENERIC[0]
DCL CONST[0..45]
DCL TEMP[0..117]
MOV TEMP[17], CONST[5]
MUL TEMP[117], IN[0], CONST[45]
ADD TEMP[116], TEMP[117], CONST[0]
MOV OUT[0], TEMP[116]
MOV OUT[1], TEMP[116]
END
MOV OUT[0], IN[0]
